name: Serving Two Masters
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that wholehearted devotion to God is essential, as emphasized in Deuteronomy 6:5 where love for the LORD must encompass all heart, soul, and might. The choice to serve God exclusively is presented as a decisive commitment, exemplified in Joshua 24:15 where one must choose whom to serve. Jesus reinforces this truth in Matthew 6:24 and Luke 16:13, declaring that no one can serve two masters, specifically God and mammon, without divided loyalties. Believers are called to be transformed by renewing their minds, as Romans 12:2 instructs, enabling them to discern and follow God's perfect will rather than conforming to worldly influences.
